mechanism: Minocycline may increase serotonergic activity and escitalopram has weak MAOI-like properties at higher doses, creating potential for additive serotonergic effects; additionally, both drugs can cause photosensitivity and CNS effects.
action: Monitor for serotonin syndrome symptoms (agitation, tremor, hyperthermia, muscle rigidity); counsel on photosensitivity precautions; combination is generally acceptable with appropriate monitoring.
